title: Add Todos
description:
## Step 1: Add Todos

The skeleton is in place. Wire up the input and button so the user can add todos to the list.

### Requirements
1. Track the input value in state
2. Clicking **Add** appends the typed text as a new `<li>` in `<ul id="todos">`
3. After adding, **clear the input**
4. Ignore empty/whitespace-only submissions
5. Each `<li>` should have a stable `key` (use `Date.now()` or a counter — anything but the array index)
